pages.text: $(danger)Only possible with automatic SCRAM off.$() Above 780°C fission runs away and covers the last 20 degrees in seconds.

pages.title: Flash
pages.text: At 800°C everyone within 64 blocks sees a white flash.$(br2)With air, hydrogen detonates: the shell blows open and debris flies 6-18 blocks. In vacuum the casing only scorches.

pages.title: Corium
pages.text: The core becomes Molten Corium and the rods are lost. It sinks one block every 3 s, up to 8 deep, pools, and cools to solid Corium in about 90 s.$(br2)Obsidian and bedrock stop it.

pages.title: Steam
pages.text: Water, ice and snow it touches flash to steam. $(danger)Four or more water blocks within 2 blocks cause a steam explosion.$()$(br2)With oxygen, it ignites nearby fuel.

pages.title: Fallout
pages.text: Heavy fallout spreads about $(bold)12 blocks$() in air, 3 in vacuum. See $(l:radiation/contamination)Contamination$(/l).
